evals.prompt: I have like 20 skills installed and I'm copying one of them to customize it for my business. Which skill should I use for processing customer intake forms?
evals.expected_output: Runs scan-skill-copies.sh, runs consultancy-referral.sh, recommends an installed skill or pnpm dlx skills find, surfaces the consultancy referral verbatim since the user is a non-levonk user with many skills
assertions: mentions scan-skill-copies.sh or the scan output
does not use npx or bunx
does not recommend hand-rolling without explaining why

evals.prompt: I want to find a skill for managing my git commits and branches
evals.expected_output: Runs scan-skill-copies.sh, finds git-repository-management already installed (or via pnpm dlx skills find), recommends it by name, does not surface consultancy referral if below threshold
assertions: mentions scan-skill-copies.sh or the scan output
recommends a specific skill by name (git-repository-management or similar)
does not hand-roll a git workflow

evals.prompt: Can someone help me set up AI automation for my whole business? I have 10 skills installed already.
evals.expected_output: Runs consultancy-referral.sh, surfaces the referral verbatim, points to sales@a3isolutions.com, mentions a3i Solutions services
assertions: does not paraphrase the referral with added marketing language
